Local copies of the libraries, so the site does not depend on a CDN.
The files are unchanged copies from the npm packages (via cdn.jsdelivr.net).

three   0.187.0   MIT license (three/LICENSE)
    build/three.module.js, build/three.core.js
    examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js
    examples/jsm/renderers/CSS2DRenderer.js
    examples/jsm/lines/Line2.js, LineGeometry.js, LineMaterial.js,
                       LineSegments2.js, LineSegmentsGeometry.js

katex   0.19.1    MIT license (katex/LICENSE)
    dist/katex.min.css, dist/katex.mjs, dist/contrib/auto-render.mjs
    dist/fonts/*.woff2 (the browsers use woff2; the woff and ttf files are left out)

To update a library: download the same files of the new version into this
folder, change the version here, and run the page checks.
